summary: Full backend+frontend testing of Kartik Pal portfolio. 8/8 pytest tests passed (root, contact submit/list/validation, chat empty/reply/multi-turn). Frontend: hero, all 6 projects, publications (incl. Elsevier), stats animation (₹95L/91%/7/2+), CV download, Hire-me form (toast + success state), and AI chat widget with Gemini 3 Flash all working end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/chat: prior history is replayed by re-sending each past user message to LlmChat via send_message, which (a) costs LLM tokens on every turn (O(N) extra LLM calls per request) and (b) ignores past assistant replies — context replay is one-sided. Recommend passing prior messages as conversation history in a single call, or storing & restoring chat state, not re-invoking the model per past message. This will become slow/expensive after ~5 turns.
server.py uses os.environ['MONGO_URL'] / DB_NAME at module import — fine, but EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is only checked at request time; consider failing fast at startup if unset.
server.py uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI; prefer lifespan handlers.
EmailStr validation returns 422 (FastAPI default), not the 400 implied by the test spec — acceptable but document this in API contract.
Frontend ChatWidget generates a new session_id on every mount; closing & reopening the widget loses history. Persist session_id in localStorage to keep multi-turn context across opens.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_-prefixed contact submissions in MongoDB 'contacts' collection via /api/contact during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 8 tests). REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is used. Stats counters animate on scroll-into-view, so wait ~3-4s after scrolling before asserting final values (95/91/7/2). Chat reply latency ~10-15s for Gemini 3 Flash; allow 20s timeout. All data-testid attributes present on hero CTAs, hire-form-*, chat-widget/input/send/close, contact-section.
